title: grow.iqdesign.ai: Keep learning feed
description: The format feed.json must follow. GitHub checks every change against this file (see .github/workflows/check-feed.yml).

updated.description: The date the list last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD. Shown on the page as 'Updated November 2, 2026'.

title.description: The session, course or podcast name.

type.description: Sets the order: ceu first, then event, course, podcast.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD for a dated session, or null.

url.description: The provider's own page, or null.

status.description: Optional. 'published' shows it; 'review' or 'draft' hides it.
